rows: I know how that looked. I was there, unfortunately. I would like another go.
I can brawl, honestly. I just want to show you I can do it without falling over.
Risk? I know I have taken too many. This time I am going to plan it properly.
Slow is good. I learned that the hard way, and I am not going to rush it.
The people deserve better than my last appearance. I am going to try to give them that.
To cut it short: I know I can do better, and I am going to show you.
I am not going to pretend the last one did not happen. I am going to move past it.
I am checking my stance, honestly. It is steadier than it was. I can tell you that much.
Technique. I am working on it. You are right to ask. Show me yours and I will show you mine.
Strikes are fine. I am learning to land them, and I am getting better.
A risk should have a plan. Mine does now. Yours?
A stall is not for me. I would rather get stuck in.
The people want a proper contest. I am going to give them one, even if it takes me a while.
You say I am not ready. Maybe. Watch me try anyway.
You are proud of your {strength}. Good, I will try again. I will try to get round it, and I will be honest about it.
I have been working on how to handle your {strength}. It is not perfect yet, but it is better.
You are not rattling me, which helps. Good, I will try again. I am still learning how to do that.
Fair enough. I deserved that. You are right, and I will take that.
I could be embarrassed about that. I am, a little. I will still do my best.
One fall. Please let it be simple. Keep me down and I will say you earned it. Fairly.
On the mat I will try to keep my feet under me. Stay close and you will see.
Grounded or standing, I am going to try my hardest.
Stand up and I will try to meet you. I want to show you the new version.
That was honest, at least. That is the kind of honesty I want to match.
Could you answer, please? I am trying. I will wait, and I will keep trying too.
Fair enough. I deserved that. I will take that as a test.
I concede that, and I am sorry for it. I will prove it at the bell.
I will give this match everything, and I will try to get it right this time.
My approach is honest and careful. You will see it on the night.
Whatever happens, I will not pretend it did not matter.
I am still going, somehow. I still have a second go to make.
I have one more try left in me, and you will see it when the bell goes.
